SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS outbound_count,
  w.name AS warehouse_name
FROM wms_outbound o
JOIN wms_warehouse w ON o.warehouse_id = w.id
WHERE o.outbound_at >= '2026-03-01' 
  AND o.outbound_at < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY w.name
ORDER BY outbound_count DESC;

SELECT 
    COALESCE(COUNT(o.id), 0) AS outbound_count,
    w.name AS warehouse_name
  FROM wms_warehouse w
  LEFT JOIN wms_outbound o 
    ON w.id = o.warehouse_id 
    AND o.outbound_at >= '2026-03-01' 
    AND o.outbound_at < '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY w.name;
